name: How long does a whole house remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole house remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole house remodel varies significantly based on the project's scope, the home's size, and the complexity of desired changes. Minor cosmetic updates might take a few months, while extensive structural alterations, floor plan reconfigurations, or additions could extend to six months or even over a year. Factors like material lead times, permit approvals, and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the initial design and planning phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole house remodel can take anywhere from a few months to over a year, depending on the project's scope and complexity.
